result.summary: Found 1 likely visual defect: a restaurant image in the main “Popular right now” section appears stuck loading, while excluded carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff are treated as expected behavior.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in “Popular right now” shows a circular loading spinner over the food image area instead of a fully loaded restaurant photo, making a prominent card look unfinished or broken.
issues.suggestion: Add a reliable image loading state with a static placeholder, timeout/retry behavior, and ensure the spinner is removed once the image loads or fails gracefully.
